content.text:
Wrote [design sketch](/tmp/exposed-shortcut-design-sol.md).

Recommend keeping the existing component handler. A named `SearchFocusShortcut` union pairs modifier and hint, selected once from platform. Exact Cmd/Ctrl+K matches focus without changing query; composition guards preserve IME behavior. Slash and Escape remain local.

Browser checks cover both platforms, rejected modifier combinations, query preservation, editable targets, IME, and listener removal after navigation.
